reply: or the fourth term (eps·T⁰, eps^p·T^q, eps^p·exp(−kT), (eps·T)^p and others) reached roughly 4e-4 to 6e-4 at best, and none gave a clean exact fit. A free-exponent eps^p·T^q fourth term came closest (NMSE 3.9e-5) but its constants were degenerate, so I don't trust it. I used 13 of the 14 tool calls.

best.code:
def equation(eps, T, params):
    return params[0]*eps**2 + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*T)*eps**1.5 + params[3]*eps*np.log(eps)*T**1.5 + params[4]*np.log(1+eps)
